supersedes.reason: API-Football 2022 season statistics probe returned no numeric xG for the first 13 fixtures; that season is structurally ineligible for the V1 PIT model input. No target results were read.

purpose: Evaluate fixed V1 probability models and hypothetical closing EV against an independent historical cohort with usable PIT xG and bookmaker-level closing AH/TOTALS prices.

cohort.target_exclusion: Exclude the 20 Premier League January 2024 fixtures used by the capability probe, even though no target results were inspected.
cohort.minimum_history: Each target team must have five earlier numeric API-Football statistics xG observations; insufficient-history targets are excluded and counted.

data_roles.development: Existing strict PIT 8,659-fixture fit and OOF; all candidate values are fixed before this cohort is opened.
data_roles.blind_test: Football-Data 2324 closing/aggregate prices joined to sanitized API-Football fixture/statistics metadata. Target result fields remain unopened until frozen model outputs are committed.

point_in_time.xg: Use only the latest five source fixtures with source kickoff strictly earlier than target kickoff; target fixture statistics and all score/result fields are forbidden inputs.
point_in_time.market: Use Football-Data Pinnacle closing PCAHH/PCAHA with AHCh, and closing PC>2.5/PC<2.5 for the fixed 2.5 TOTALS diagnostic. Closing prices are not T-30/T-15 execution quotes.
point_in_time.mapping: Join by competition, season, UTC kickoff, and normalized home/away identities; ambiguous or conflicting mappings are excluded and reported.

fixed_models.production: Current deployed V1 parameters at revision 1de3c1ef.
fixed_models.ah_candidate: home_adjustment=0.208545, attack_adjustment=0.663475, defence_adjustment=-0.112027 from frozen fit 8e7d654b; no refit on this cohort.
fixed_models.totals_candidate: total_goals_intercept=0.885958, total_goals_scale=0.701191 from frozen fit 3671335b; no refit on this cohort.

freeze_order: Construct PIT xG features and closing-market rows without reading target result fields.
Run all fixed models and persist/hash full model probabilities and hypothetical EV inputs.
Only then open target results and compute settlement diagnostics.

acceptance.primary: For AH and TOTALS separately, candidate-minus-production and candidate-minus-closing-market paired Brier/log-loss differences must have one-sided 95% fixture bootstrap upper bounds <= 0; no pooling across markets.
acceptance.diagnostic: Report AH/TOTALS direction, closing cashflow EV distribution, ECE and calibration curves; these do not select parameters.
acceptance.minimum_coverage: At least 500 eligible fixtures per market; otherwise report INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE and do not draw a repair conclusion.
acceptance.one_x_two: Diagnostic only, never a pass gate.
